name: PdxProvide
description:
Makes a value available to everything it wraps, like Blazor's CascadingValue, under a context
token; when two provide the same token, the nearest ancestor wins.

members.name: token
members.description: The context token the value is provided under (single value mode): `context<T>('name')`.

members.name: value
members.description: Value to provide (for single value mode). Reactive if signal.

members.name: values
members.description: Multiple values, a `Map` of token → value. Takes priority over token/value.

slots.description: The content placed inside the element.
